bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs, springboard/sdk/src/image_source.rs, springboard/sdk/src/image_metadata.rs, springboard/sdk/src/image_animation.rs, springboard/sdk/src/picture_writer.rs over springboard/render/src/cg/imageio (all formats); springboard/src/shell/photos/exif.rs and springboard/src/shell/camera/jpeg.rs remain the system-layer readers and writers
summary: Decoding and writing for PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, ICO and TIFF (WebP is read only) live in springboard/render/src/cg/imageio, with EXIF, TIFF and GPS metadata, orientation, thumbnails and animation frames. Apps now reach them through the SDK: graphics_imageio and image_source for pixels and sizes, image_metadata for EXIF, GPS and upright decode, image_animation for frames and delays, and picture_writer for writing with metadata. Not yet verified on Midget. No XMP or IPTC, no HEIC, TGA or RAW, and no colour profile or HDR handling.

features.feature: Image source: decode from data or file
features.note: Reads the header first (format, size and EXIF orientation), refuses oversized pictures, and reads a file with a byte limit (read_file) before decoding any format of the cg::imageio codecs (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF; WebP read only) into premultiplied RGBA. Tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-07. Gap: not yet verified on Midget, and the decode is whole-picture and synchronous.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/picture_writer.rs (PictureWriter over cg::imageio::ImageDestination), springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs (encode, encode_jpeg); system layer: springboard/src/pngenc.rs:9, springboard/src/shell/camera/jpeg.rs:284, springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs:343; springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-07.rs
features.note: Apps write PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF and ICO with orientation, date, camera, software, location, altitude, quality, frame delay and loop count, tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-07. Gap: WebP is read only (no pure-Rust encoder here), and the shell's own picture encoders stay in the system layer; not yet verified on Midget.

features.feature: Format coverage (GIF, HEIC, WebP, TIFF, TGA, DNG, RAW)
features.apple: Image I/O supported type list (Image Properties, format-specific property keys)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-image-i-o, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Only PNG and JPEG are decoded or written. GIF, WebP, HEIC, TIFF, TGA and RAW are recognised by name in the browser or the Files type table only.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/image_source.rs (thumbnail_size, thumbnail, upright_size); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (fit_dims); wired: springboard/apps/files/src/views/options.rs (picture_thumb, blit_thumb); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-07.rs
features.note: Thumbnails fit a box without enlarging and are turned upright by the EXIF orientation, so a rotated photo gets the right box shape (tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-07). Gap: the whole picture is still decoded before it is scaled down, and apps cannot ask the codec for a subsampled decode.

features.apple: No direct equivalent (Image I/O reads the header first)
features.note: Pictures over the side limit (MAX_SIDE) or over an app's pixel budget are refused from the header before decoding, tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-07. Gap: the shell does not apply a budget of its own, and the limit is not yet checked on Midget.

features.feature: EXIF metadata read (camera, date, exposure, size)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/image_metadata.rs (read: PictureInfo with camera, date, exposure, f-number, ISO, focal length, dpi, altitude, software, lens model); system layer: springboard/src/shell/photos/exif.rs:113, wired in springboard/apps/files/src/info.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-07.rs
features.note: PictureInfo reads camera, date, exposure, f-number, ISO, focal length, dpi, altitude, software and lens model from the file that the cg::imageio EXIF reader fills; the software and altitude reads are tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-07. Gap: maker notes and XMP packets are skipped as opaque, and the shell's own reader is not yet checked on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/image_metadata.rs (decode_upright, orientation via cg::imageio::orient_image); springboard/sdk/src/image_source.rs (ImageSource::decode_upright, upright_size); springboard/render/src/cg/imageio/mod.rs (orient_image); system layer: springboard/src/shell/photos/mod.rs (decode_upright); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-07.rs
features.note: SDK apps get upright pixels from image_metadata::decode_upright and image_source::ImageSource::decode_upright, and thumbnails from image_source use the same rotation (tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-07). Gap: the shell's upright decode is not yet checked against the SDK on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/picture_writer.rs (date_taken, orientation, camera, software, altitude); springboard/render/src/cg/imageio/exif.rs (build_block); system layer: springboard/src/shell/camera/jpeg.rs:249; springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-07.rs
features.note: Writes DateTimeOriginal, Orientation, camera make and model, Software and altitude for JPEG, PNG and TIFF; the JPEG values read back in parity_sdk-complete-07. Gap: exposure and lens tags are not written by the SDK writer, and the camera's own writer is not yet checked on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/image_metadata.rs (Location read, altitude_m, decimal_to_dms, dms_to_decimal); springboard/sdk/src/picture_writer.rs (location and altitude write); springboard/render/src/cg/imageio/exif.rs (GPS_TAGS); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-07.rs
features.note: Latitude, longitude and altitude are read and written (decimal degrees and metres, negative below sea level); the altitude round trip is tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-07. Gap: the GPS time stamp, speed and direction are not exposed, and the values are not yet checked on Midget.

features.apple: CGImageMetadata, CGMutableImageMetadata, CGImageMetadataTag, IPTC Dictionary Keys
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 3 (theme-06, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No XMP or IPTC parser or writer in springboard/.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/image_animation.rs (read: frames, delay_ms, loop_count; frame_at, shown_ms, duration_ms); springboard/sdk/src/picture_writer.rs (frame writing); springboard/core/src/gifframes.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-07.rs
features.note: Apps read every GIF frame with its delay and loop count, get the frame on screen at an elapsed time (zero delays shown for 100 ms, the loop count applied), and write animated GIFs; tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-07. Gap: APNG frames are not composited, because the PNG reader parses the frame count but does not decode the frames.

features.note: Wave 4 (theme-18, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Images are treated as sRGB. No ICC, gain map or HDR support.
Vision Pro media. No BifrOSt counterpart.

features.feature: Image file types for the type system
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/uttype.rs (type_for_extension, conforms), springboard/src/files/fs.rs:49 (kind_of: PNG and JPEG are Image)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. UTType for images is in the SDK as controls::uttype. Only PNG and JPEG count as images; other formats are not image types.

features.feature: Image data in drag and drop
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs (register_types, image_format_of, accepts_image), docs/bifrost-ui.md:513 (public.image accepts PNG and JPEG); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-07.rs
features.note: An image drop is typed by its picture type or file name, and a window that takes public.image takes every picture format (tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-07). Gap: image data does not travel with the drag; the drag payload needs a change to the shell protocol first.

Tile geometry and a bounded TileCache that a streaming provider fills on demand, evicting the least recently used tile, are tested headless in render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-37.rs. Gap: no decoder or pixel source feeds the cache yet, and the model is not wired into apps or the shell or tested on Midget.

gaps: No XMP or IPTC metadata in the SDK; the metadata block carries EXIF, TIFF and GPS only.
HEIC, TGA and RAW are not recognised by the codecs; WebP is read only.
The Photos and camera code still use their own encoders (springboard/src/pngenc.rs writes uncompressed PNG) and are not moved onto picture_writer.
APNG frame access is not verified.
No colour profile (ICC) or HDR gain map handling; images are treated as sRGB.
No tiled or streaming image provider for very large pictures.
Not yet verified on Midget: every row built on parity/team-n-image-i-o.
